entities.name: Élie Dor de Lastours

entities.summary: Élie Marie Gabriel Dor de Lastours, also known as Élie, Count de Lastours, was a French fencer, tennis player, and politician. He competed in the individual épée and men's doubles events at the 1900 Summer Olympics.
